fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Djibouti.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 6 meses posterior a la fecha de llegada a Yibuti.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You must have a visa to enter Djibouti.
entry.es: Se necesita visado para entrar en Yibuti.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to enter Djibouti.

entry.en: You can buy a tourist visa on arrival with cash payment in US dollars, or apply online beforehand.
entry.es: Puede comprar un visado de turista a la llegada pagando en efectivo en dólares estadounidenses, o solicitarlo en línea antes de viajar.
entry.quote: You can buy a tourist visa when you arrive in Djibouti with payment in cash in US dollars. You can also apply for a visa online before travelling

entry.en: You must have evidence of your onward journey.
entry.es: Debe tener pruebas de su viaje de continuación.
entry.quote: You must have evidence of your onward journey.

entry.en: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Necesita un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si viene de un país de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Most nationals can get a visa on arrival, valid for one month, for 15,000 DJF or 90 USD as of November 2018.
entry.es: La mayoría de los nacionales pueden obtener un visado a la llegada, válido un mes, por 15.000 DJF o 90 USD en noviembre de 2018.
entry.quote: Most nationals can get a visa on arrival for 15,000 DJF or 90 USD (as of November 2018), valid for one month.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to the Djibouti-Eritrea border.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a la frontera entre Yibuti y Eritrea.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the Djibouti-Eritrea border.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Djibouti.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Yibuti.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Djibouti.

safety.en: There are unmarked landmines near the Djibouti-Eritrea border.
safety.es: Hay minas terrestres sin señalizar cerca de la frontera entre Yibuti y Eritrea.
safety.quote: There are unmarked landmines near the Djibouti-Eritrea border.

safety.es: El nivel de conducción es en general deficiente.

safety.en: Photographing infrastructure such as ports, public buildings, airports, military facilities and bridges is prohibited.
safety.es: Está prohibido fotografiar infraestructuras como puertos, edificios públicos, aeropuertos, instalaciones militares y puentes.
safety.quote: Photographing infrastructure, such as ports, public buildings, airports, military facilities, and bridges, is prohibited.

safety.en: There is a significant risk of piracy and armed robbery in the Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean.
safety.es: Hay un riesgo significativo de piratería y robo a mano armada en el golfo de Adén y el océano Índico.
safety.quote: There is a significant risk of piracy and armed robbery in the Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean.

health.en: Medical facilities in Djibouti are limited, so you need adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds.
health.es: Los servicios médicos en Yibuti son limitados, por lo que se necesita un seguro de salud de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Djibouti are limited. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

health.en: Tap water is not safe to drink unless it has been boiled or otherwise sterilized.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es segura para beber a menos que se hierva o se esterilice de otro modo.
health.quote: Tap water is not safe to drink unless it has been boiled or otherwise sterilized.

health.en: Malaria risk exists year-round, mainly the falciparum form.
health.es: El riesgo de malaria existe todo el año, sobre todo la forma falciparum.
health.quote: Malaria risk, predominantly in the malignant falciparum form, exists year-round.

health.en: Doctors and hospitals may expect immediate cash payment for any medical treatment.
health.es: Los médicos y hospitales pueden esperar el pago inmediato en efectivo por cualquier tratamiento médico.
health.quote: Doctors and hospitals may expect immediate cash payment for any medical treatment.

health.en: Health risks in Djibouti include dengue, Zika virus and schistosoma.
health.es: Los riesgos sanitarios en Yibuti incluyen dengue, virus del Zika y esquistosomiasis.
health.quote: See what health risks you’ll face in Djibouti, including: - dengue - Zika virus - schistosoma

health.en: Cholera is described as a serious risk and precautions are essential.
health.es: Se describe el cólera como un riesgo grave y las precauciones son esenciales.
health.quote: Cholera is also a serious risk and precautions are essential.

help.en: Ambulance numbers are 21 35 09 62 or 21 35 27 12, fire is 18 and police is 17.
help.es: Los números de ambulancia son 21 35 09 62 o 21 35 27 12, bomberos 18 y policía 17.

help.en: FCDO can be called in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, for urgent help about a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas, si un amigo o familiar necesita ayuda urgente en el extranjero.

getting_in.en: Djibouti-Ambouli International Airport (JIB) is 5 km south of the city.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Djibouti-Ambouli (JIB) está a 5 km al sur de la ciudad.
getting_in.quote: The airport is 5 km (3.1 mi) south of the city.

getting_in.en: Passenger train services between Ethiopia and Djibouti City were restarted in December 2016.
getting_in.es: Los servicios de tren de pasajeros entre Etiopía y la ciudad de Yibuti se reanudaron en diciembre de 2016.
getting_in.quote: Passenger train services between Ethiopia and Djibouti City were restarted in December 2016.

getting_in.en: There are ferry services connecting Djibouti to Yemen.
getting_in.es: Hay servicios de ferri que conectan Yibuti con Yemen.
getting_in.quote: There are ferry services connecting Djibouti to Yemen.

getting_in.en: If you plan to enter by land you have to arrange visas in advance.
getting_in.es: Si piensa entrar por tierra, debe gestionar el visado con antelación.
getting_in.quote: If you plan to enter by land you have to arrange for visas in advance.

getting_in.en: Roads to Assab (Eritrea) and west into Ethiopia via Dikhil have generally poor conditions and personal security might be at risk.
getting_in.es: Las carreteras a Assab (Eritrea) y hacia el oeste a Etiopía por Dikhil están en general en mal estado y la seguridad personal podría estar en riesgo.
getting_in.quote: road conditions are generally poor and personal security might be at risk when travelling, particularly to Ethiopia.

getting_around.en: Taxi fares can increase by 50% after dark.
getting_around.es: Las tarifas de taxi pueden subir un 50 % después del anochecer.
getting_around.quote: Fares can increase by 50% after dark.

getting_around.en: Ferries sail daily from L'Escale (Djibouti) to Tadjoura and Obock, taking about three hours.
getting_around.es: Hay ferris diarios de L'Escale (Yibuti) a Tadjoura y Obock, con unas tres horas de trayecto.
getting_around.quote: Ferry services sail daily from L'Escale (Djibouti) to Tadjoura and Obock. The journey takes about three hours.

getting_around.en: Buses operate from Djibouti to most towns and villages, and they leave when they are full.
getting_around.es: Hay autobuses de Yibuti a la mayoría de pueblos y aldeas, y salen cuando están llenos.
getting_around.quote: Buses operate from Djibouti to most towns and villages throughout the country. Buses leave when they are full.

getting_around.en: You should avoid driving after dark outside Djibouti city because vehicles do not always have working headlights and livestock may be on the roads.
getting_around.es: Conviene evitar conducir de noche fuera de la ciudad de Yibuti porque los vehículos no siempre tienen faros que funcionen y puede haber ganado en la carretera.
getting_around.quote: You should avoid driving after dark outside the city of Djibouti. Vehicles do not always have working headlights and there may be livestock on the roads.

money.en: Credit and debit cards are not widely accepted, so you should carry enough cash.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito no se aceptan ampliamente, así que conviene llevar suficiente efectivo.
money.quote: Credit and debit cards are not widely accepted.

money.en: ATMs are normally available in Djibouti City but may not accept Mastercard.
money.es: Normalmente hay cajeros en la ciudad de Yibuti, pero puede que no acepten Mastercard.
money.quote: ATMs are normally available in Djibouti City, but they may not accept Mastercard.

money.en: The currency of Djibouti is the Djiboutian franc (DJF), which is pegged to the US dollar.
money.es: La moneda de Yibuti es el franco yibutiano (DJF), vinculado al dólar estadounidense.
money.quote: The currency of Djibouti is the Djiboutian franc, denoted by the symbol "Fdj" (ISO currency code: DJF). The Djiboutian franc is pegged to the US dollar.

money.en: Street money changers are generally honest brokers, but it is still advisable to check the exchange rate in advance.
money.es: Los cambistas callejeros suelen ser honestos, pero aun así conviene comprobar el tipo de cambio de antemano.
money.quote: Whilst generally honest brokers it is still advisable to have yours ready and check the exchange rate in advance.

money.en: Average price per meal outside tourist areas is US$4 including drink.
money.es: El precio medio de una comida fuera de las zonas turísticas es de 4 USD con bebida.
money.quote: Average price per meal outside tourist areas is US$4 including drink.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan you should not eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán no se debe comer, beber, fumar ni mascar chicle en público durante el día.
etiquette.quote: eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car

etiquette.en: Djibouti is a Muslim country, and shorts are generally not appropriate outside hotels, beaches or sport activities.
etiquette.es: Yibuti es un país musulmán y los pantalones cortos no suelen ser apropiados fuera de hoteles, playas o actividades deportivas.
etiquette.quote: Shorts are generally not appropriate outside of hotels, beaches or sport activities.

etiquette.en: Homosexuality is not explicitly criminalized but remains broadly unaccepted.
etiquette.es: La homosexualidad no está penalizada explícitamente, pero sigue siendo ampliamente rechazada.
etiquette.quote: While homosexuality is not explicitly criminalized it remains broadly unaccepted

etiquette.en: Drinking alcohol is allowed, but drunken behaviour can bring a 2-year prison sentence.
etiquette.es: Beber alcohol está permitido, pero el comportamiento en estado de embriaguez puede conllevar dos años de cárcel.
etiquette.quote: Drinking alcohol is allowed, but you can get a 2-year prison sentence for drunken behaviour.

connectivity.en: There is a 3G network running on 900MHz, with a maximum speed of 7mbps.
connectivity.es: Hay una red 3G que funciona a 900 MHz, con una velocidad máxima de 7 Mbps.
connectivity.quote: There is a 3G phone network in the country that runs on 900MHz. The maximum speed is 7mbps but expect it to be lower.

connectivity.en: You can get 1GB of data for about US$3.
connectivity.es: Se puede conseguir 1 GB de datos por unos 3 USD.
connectivity.quote: You can get 1GB of data for about US$3.
